answer: PoA binds every identity to a bonded collateral escrow and links its attestations by state and timing. When k controlled identities equivocate on the same decision, correlated slashing grows as O(k^2); once the swarm is detected, an exponential multiplier applies to aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery. Splitting stake therefore cannot evade accountability, whether a node is tagged ferrous, orchard, or summit.
